archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Luxury (Godly website level, elegant green)

heading.style: Elegant, serif, refined. Use tracking-tight for large text.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(10, 46, 32, 0.1) on light mode surfaces
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers and overlays. NO fully transparent headers.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-24 for sections. High breathing room.
layouts.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetrical. col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero cards, col-span-4 for supporting.

motion.hero: Framer-motion masked line-by-line text reveal. Kinetic and elegant.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee. Slow, elegant editorial ribbon. Spacing gap-24.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero image and background elements using framer-motion useScroll.

images.description: Green glowing nodes - Abstract brain connections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Text on dark backgrounds must be high contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the asymmetric main page layouts (Bento grids).
Use Shadcn only for form components in the CTA/Footer (Input, Textarea, Button).
Implement a language toggle (ID/EN) using a simple React state or Context in the navigation.
Hero section must use Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveal ('Brain Energy menuju Indonesia Emas 2045').
Implement the Grand Narrative ecosystem flow (PERDOSNI -> GESOI -> otaQku -> ICC) as an overlapping glassmorphism card stack or horizontal timeline, not a boring flowchart.
Number the manifesto chapters (4 mission pillars).
Roadmap timeline 3-7-10 years should be vertical or horizontal but visually distinct.
DO NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Ensure the header uses glassmorphism and is never fully transparent over the hero.
Install and use lenis for smooth scrolling.
Install and use react-fast-marquee for the editorial slow marquee.
universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
